job.name: kept-grounded-film
job.prompt: A restrained photorealistic continuous shot of exactly the supplied open drawer. Absolutely fixed camera and identical framing throughout. Inventory must remain exactly the same: the existing paper envelope, pressed red poppy, photograph, wooden drawer, table and glass. There is NO RIBBON, NO STRING, NO FABRIC anywhere in this scene; do not invent or introduce any objects. Motion is only a very small lift of the existing free upper corner of the envelope, bending like real opaque paper while its lower portion remains on the drawer floor, then gently settling. The pressed flower stays resting on its paper, never floats. Soft window illumination shifts subtly across the existing wood and paper. No levitation, no object appearing or disappearing, no morphing, no hands, no lettering, no dissolve, no cuts, no camera movement. End on the original reference composition and hold for the final second.
